qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Mission-critical severe-service valves and actuators where failure causes catastrophic industrial shutdowns. High-margin proprietary aftermarket parts (>45% of sales) deliver defensible pricing power and ~13% ROIC.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 10, REJECT). Industrial flow-control and valve engineering group. While critical valves have high switching costs, IMI's largest division (Process Automation, >40% of sales) faces an active terminal headwind under Macrotrend [4] (Energy Transition & Resource Limits) due to heavy exposure to upstream oil & gas, petrochemicals, and thermal power.
qualitative.evidence: Process Automation generates ~£900m of IMI's £2.2B revenue, serving upstream hydrocarbon extraction, LNG, and conventional power generation. Decarbonization and energy transition create multi-decade demand headwinds and stranded asset risk for conventional thermal power and fossil process valves, capping CAP at 10 years.
